Get ready to close the Opportunity:

  • Ensure all pre conditions are met pre-drawdown
  • Update the Product record with the Reference number before closing the Opportunity
  • Do you need to send Instructions to the Settlements Team and to file/register security docs and also instructions to CST for Drawdown?
  • Check that facilities have been correctly drawn
  • If you have won the opportunity from a competitor, have you recorded from who?
